{{Quote|Jhara, my dear. Thank the Force he did not get you. The dark side is going for the boy. Caeleb must be saved.|Gel, to Jhara|<ref name="Child of Light" />}}
'''Jhara''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]] the during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Jhara escorted a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents to the [[Farm/Legends|farm]] of her grandfather, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Gel (Jedi)|Gel]], after he requested that the Alliance take custody of the prophesied "Child of Light" [[Caeleb]]. On arrival, Jhara and the Rebels found Gel to be critically injured following [[Torture/Legends|torture]] by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Tol Skaros]], who also sought Caeleb. Jhara was subsequently wounded by Skaros and she was flown off-world by the Rebels to the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari cruiser]] ''[[Home One/Legends|Home One]]'' for medical treatment.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I tried to resist him but he was absolute evil. He told me he had captured you and would feed you to his hounds but I didn't reveal the boy's location. I tried&hellip;I tried&hellip;I just didn't have the strength. Once again, I have failed the Force&hellip;|Gel, to Jhara, on his interrogation by Tol Skaros|<ref name="Child of Light" />}}
Jhara was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Child of Light" /> born in around [[13 BBY/Legends|13 BBY]]<ref name="Dates" /> who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The granddaughter of the failed [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Gel (Jedi)|Gel]], Jhara was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] though not a Force user. She lived at her grandfather's [[Farm/Legends|farm]] and on occasion Gel mentioned to her the location of a spot sited nearby that was devoid of the Force, though she never visited the place in person.<ref name="Child of Light" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Dates" /> Gel became concerned for the safety of [[Caeleb]], the prophesied "Child of Light," a [[Youngling/Legends|boy]] strong in the Force whom the Jedi watched over. Gel sent a message to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] resistance movement to request that the Rebel Jedi [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] take the child into the Alliance's custody. At Gel's behest, Jhara traveled to the village [[Dalia (township)|Dalia]] to await Skywalker's coming, with instructions to escort the Jedi to Gel's [[Farm/Legends|farm]]. Unavailable for travel to Dalicron-4, Skywalker sent a group of Rebel agents to Dalia in his stead and the Rebels soon endeared themselves to the local residents by rescuing the missing boy [[Zanner]]. Jhara heard word of the Rebels' and made contact with them at the [[Doc Aloor|house]] of the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] [[Aloor]].<ref name="Child of Light" /> She became nervous upon learning that Skywalker was not among the Rebel team<ref name="Soulsaber">"[[Soulsaber (adventure)|Soulsaber]]"</ref> but the group convinced her of their sincerity and she acquired some [[cracian thumper]] mounts from the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Meebo]] for her and the agents to use for the journey to Gel's farm.<ref name="Child of Light" />

Jhara led the Rebels into some [[Forest/Legends|woods]] on the far side of Dalia's landing field on a six [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] journey through the forest to Gel's home. During the journey, Jhara adjusted the speed at which she traveled to suit the riding ability of the Rebels. As the group progressed to the farm, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Tol Skaros]] attacked and interrogated Gel, seeking information concerning Caeleb's location. The Whiphid threatened to feed Gel to the Dark Jedi's [[Nek/Legends|nek battle dogs]] if he not comply and left Gel's body shattered and fatally wounded. When Jhara and the Rebels came within sight of their destination, roughly one [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] from the farm, Jhara sensed something to be amiss and hurried her pace. She burst into the farm and was at Gel's side as the wounded Jedi told her of Skaros' attack and with his last breaths urged the Rebels to go to the spot devoid of the Force and save Caeleb from the Whiphid. Jhara sobbed uncontrollably as her grandfather [[Death/Legends|passed away]] from his injuries and once she regained her composure placed his body on a bed, under some covers.<ref name="Child of Light" />

After a gathering a [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]] left over from Gel's service during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Jhara mounted up and led the Rebels on a three hour journey to Caeleb's location. Arriving amid an assault by Skaros and the Whiphid's nek battle dogs and [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droids]] on the homestead where Caeleb lived with his parents, Jhara attempted to take down the Dark Jedi. However, she was shot down by a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt between her shoulders and fell from her cracian thumper, suffering critical injuries. The Rebels defeated Skaros and returned to Dalia with Jhara and Caeleb so that she could receive treatment from Aloor.<ref name="Child of Light" /> Jhara subsequently accompanied the Rebels and Caeleb away from Dalicron-4 on the agents' [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Lazy Katarn]]''. She and Caeleb<ref name="Soulsaber" /> were flown to the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari cruiser]] ''[[Home One/Legends|Home One]]''<ref name="Child of Light" /> and placed in the custody of [[Kylbar]],<ref name="Soulsaber" /> an [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to the Rebel leader [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]]. Upon arrival, Jhara was escorted away to receive further medical attention and a spell in a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]]<ref name="Child of Light" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Something's wrong.|Jhara, to the Rebels, sensing something amiss on the approach to Gel's farm|<ref name="Child of Light" />}}
Jhara had [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and auburn [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. She was an experienced cracian thumper rider and was impatient with individuals who had poor riding skills. She deeply loved her grandfather Gel and his death greatly saddened her, leaving her determined to challenge Gel's killer, Tol Skaros.<ref name="Child of Light" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jhara was created by [[Lee Pickler]] and appeared in ''[[Child of Light]]'', a [[2000]] roleplaying adventure set within ''[[Star Wars Legends]]'' continuity that was published by [[RPGA]] as the opening instalment of the [[Child of Light saga|''Child of Light'' saga]].<ref name="Child of Light" /> She was also referenced in the second<ref name="Soulsaber" /> and third adventures of the saga,<ref name="Light and Dark">"[[Light and Dark (adventure)|Light and Dark]]"</ref> [[Soulsaber (adventure)|''Soulsaber'']]<ref name="Soulsaber" /> and [[Light and Dark (adventure)|''Light and Dark'']],<ref name="Light and Dark" /> released in [[2001]]<ref name="Soulsaber" /> and [[2002]] respectively.<ref name="Light and Dark" />

In ''Child of Light'', the players roleplay as the Rebel agents that Jhara encounters on Dalicron-4. When Jhara and the Rebels arrive at Gel's farm, Jhara immediately bursts in to check on her grandfather and does not respond to any attempt by the player characters to deter her. After she is shot down during the battle against Skaros it is possible for the Rebels to provide medical aide to her to stabilize her condition. When the Rebel agents escort her back to Dalia it is possible for the player characters to leave her at the settlement or to take her with them when they depart Dalicron-4. It is also possible for Skaros' under-cover Dark Jedi master [[Thaum Rystra]] to offer her assistance if the player characters mention Jhara's condition to him.<ref name="Child of Light" /> A recap of the events of ''Child of Light'' included in ''Soulsaber''<ref name="Soulsaber" /> and ''Light and Dark''<ref name="Light and Dark" /> states that the Rebels took Jhara with them and left her in the care of Kylbar, thus indicating that to be the official outcome.<ref name="Soulsaber" />
